FROMGIT: soc: qcom: cmd-db: Make endian-agnostic This driver deals with memory that is stored in little-endian format. Update the structures with the proper little-endian types and then do the proper conversions when reading the fields. Note that we compare the ids with a memcmp() because we already pad out the string 'id' field to exactly 8 bytes with the strncpy() onto the stack.
